class.name: VoxelMesherTransvoxelMultiMaterial
class.brief_description: Implements smooth SDF meshing with one mesh surface per voxel material index.
class.description: Uses the Transvoxel algorithm to polygonize [constant VoxelBuffer.CHANNEL_SDF], while using 8-bit values from [constant VoxelBuffer.CHANNEL_INDICES] to split visible geometry into independent surfaces. Materials are looked up from [member library] by surface material index. This mesher is intended for the same data layout as [constant VoxelMesherTransvoxel.TEXTURES_SINGLE_S4]. It does not expose Mixel4, atlas, or triplanar texturing. When using LOD, shaders assigned through the material library must include the Transvoxel vertex-position logic used by smooth voxel terrain.

members.member: Minimum interpolation margin from cell corners when placing generated vertices. Increasing this can reduce very thin triangles at the cost of small surface shape changes.
Material library used to resolve mesh surface material indices.
If enabled, material IDs stored on air voxels are ignored when deciding which material owns visible SDF surface geometry.
If enabled, generates Transvoxel transition surfaces for LOD seams.
Scale used for generated planar UVs.
